title: Resident Evil 4 (GameCube, NTSC-U)
notes: Disc 1 and Disc 2 share one main.dol. Sources: gbox/re_games.py (AR / Gecko codes, capstone over main.dol, Dolphin watchpoints on the Spark), gbox/re4_merc_bot.py (live reads while the Mercenaries bot plays) and docs/mercenaries.md.

groups.game: Where the game is: room, money, the disc
groups.pad: The controller as the game reads it
groups.prompt: The action-button prompt and QTEs (the action manager 0x80278AE4)
groups.aev: Area events and items (AEV / ITA): doors, ladders, pickups, zones (AevMgr 0x80289B3C)
groups.menu: The title and its menus: title.cpp's task and its work area (gbox/re4_menus.py, docs/re4-menus.md)

game.disc_id.description: Disc id at the start of MEM1
game.disc_id.evidence: every GameCube game: the boot header is copied to 0x80000000

game.room.description: Current room 0xSSRR (stage, room): 0x0100 = r100; 0x04RR = the Mercenaries
game.room.evidence: gbox/re_games.py pG+0x4FA8; re4_merc_bot in_mercenaries; 0x0400 live 2026-10-20 (Mercenaries village)

game.stage.description: Stage of the current room (its high byte)

player.ptr.description: The player em (lwz r3,-0x673C(r13)); EmMgr slot 0
player.ptr.evidence: gbox/re_games.py P_PLAYER; the grenade-owner patch reads it the same way

player.pos.evidence: gbox/re4_merc_bot.py snapshot (the bot steers on it at 20 Hz, 2026-10-20)

player.facing.description: Facing: atan2(dx, dz) of where he looks; the stick's left turns it +

player.aim_pitch.description: Aim pitch while R is held (+ up)
player.aim_pitch.evidence: gbox/re4_merc_bot.py AIM_PITCH: a value written while R is held moves the laser (2026-10-20)

merc.timer.evidence: gbox/re_games.py MERC_TIMER (AR code); the bot's round clock, 2026-10-20

merc.combo_timer.description: Time left for the next kill to extend the combo (frames; reloaded from 0x802B17F0)
merc.combo_timer.evidence: docs/mercenaries.md COMBO_WINDOW: stored by the add-kill routine 0x8001EEA8 at 0x8001EF40, counted down at 0x8001DD88

merc.time_pickup.description: Seconds the time pickup being taken adds (every Mercenaries time pickup goes through it)
merc.time_pickup.evidence: docs/mercenaries.md (pG+0x4F7E, the clock routine's mulli x30)

pad.held.description: Buttons held this frame (GameCube PAD_BUTTON bits); pad.held_prev is the frame before
pad.held.evidence: GameCube SDK PAD_BUTTON layout (gbox/re_games.py PAD_HELD: A 0x100, B 0x200, R 0x20, L 0x40, Z 0x10); live 2026-10-20 (session e2771e1c892e46e9-d7dbf0129c4f4b1b, polled every 2 ms while the bot played): all 65 changes in 20 s showed here one game frame (29-43 ms) before 0x80287E9E

pad.held_prev.description: Buttons held the frame before (gbox/re_games.py PAD_HELD reads this one)
pad.held_prev.evidence: live 2026-10-20: follows pad.held one game frame later (see pad.held)

enemies.description: Live Ganados: EmMgr slots 1..count whose flags & 0x601 are set and that have an ESL entry

save.extras.description: 'Extra' unlock bits, MSB first (bits 4..7 = the Mercenaries characters); byte 0 = 0xFF: every extra game

prompt.kind.description: Button kind of the prompt drawn this frame, 0 = no prompt (cleared by the action manager's process 0x800B1950, stored by its draw 0x800B1AFC); gbox/re4_ram_prompts.py KINDS
prompt.kind.evidence: capstone over main.dol: stb r31,-0x6CE0 at 0x800B1D0C, the press check 0x800B1D24 per kind; live 2026-10-20 (session e2771e1c892e46e9-d7dbf0129c4f4b1b, 12 Hz beside screen_prompt): 32 prompts, TAKE 19, OPEN 6, SHAKE OFF 4, KICK 2, JUMP DOWN 1, each as the frame showed (docs/evidence/re4-ram-prompts)

prompt.valid.description: An action passed its check this frame (ActMgr +0x42; its prompt is up unless pG+0x58 & 0x1000 or the node's flag 8)

prompt.off.description: Actions are off (ActMgr +0x41 = pG+0x170 & 0x100: events, menus)

prompt.count.description: Nodes taken this frame (ActMgr +0x40; 0 after each frame's reset, so mostly 0 when read)
prompt.count.evidence: the node allocator 0x800B2048 (8 nodes of 0x18 from +0x44)

prompt.label_shown.description: Message slot 1 (the prompt's label) is on screen (MesMgr 0x80213D74 slot 1 +4 bit 0)
prompt.label_shown.evidence: the draw calls 0x800238D8 with slot 1; the slot set-up 0x80023AA0 sets bits 0-1, the update 0x80023C54 clears bit 0 when bit 1 stayed clear; live 2026-10-20: on with every prompt, off between

prompt.label_message.description: The message slot 1 draws: core message bank 0 entry (label + 0x16); gbox/re4_ram_prompts.py maps it back to the label

prompt.nodes.description: The action manager's node pool: this frame's candidates (prompt.count are fresh; the rest are last frame's)

callback.description: run when its button is pressed

data.description: the AEV entry, item or object

aev.mgr.evidence: the init 0x8014B958 stores it; every AEV routine loads -0x6608(r13)

aev.count.description: Entries in the room's AEV table

aev.entries.description: The room's area events (doors, ladders, areas, check spots)
aev.entries.evidence: AEV handlers 0x8020CAD4, set-up 0x8014F420, check 0x8014BE50; gbox/re4_navmap.py reads the same table from the disc

data_pos.description: door: destination x y z facing; ladder: stand x y z facing

aev.items_count.description: Entries in the room's ITA (items) table

aev.items.description: The room's items: Mercenaries hourglasses (0x73 Time Bonus, 0x75 Combo Bonus) and pickups; enabled = still there to TAKE
aev.items.evidence: 0x80152C08 labels them TAKE (0x28); taking one clears +0x34 bit 0 (0x8014FC40); the Village's entries (0x73 x5, 0x75 x3, herbs, grenades) read from RAM 2026-10-20

aev.inside.description: Entries whose zone holds an em this frame: bit 0x80000000 >> (index & 31) of word index >> 5 (Leon's: entries with who & 1)
aev.inside.evidence: 0x8014BB64 (called by the check 0x8014BE50), cleared each frame by 0x8014BBE0; live 2026-10-20: the Village's area zones 2-5 / 8 as Leon ran, and the item's own zone (0x80) while its TAKE was up

aev.fired.description: Entries that fired this frame (same bit layout)

game.routine.description: The game's main routine byte (pG+0x20, the next three are its sub-steps): 3 while playing a room, 4 while an area-event door changes the room
game.routine.evidence: the AEV door handler 0x8014CA4C (stb r7=4,0x20); 03 00 00 00 through the Mercenaries rounds live 2026-10-20

game.door_room.description: Destination room of the door being opened (AEV +0x6C / +0x6D)

game.room_before.description: The room before the last door

player.routine.description: Leon's routine byte (+0xFC; +0xFD..0xFF are its sub-steps): prompts only while 0 (0x8013E3D0)
player.routine.evidence: the context checks 0x8013D4E8, the action check 0x8013E3D0, the object action 0x80141794; live 2026-10-20: 01 00 01 00 through a SHAKE OFF grab, 04 00 01 00 opening a door and kicking

player.action_object.description: The object of Leon's object action: a door em (em id 0x41) or the Ganado he kicks
player.action_object.evidence: 0x80141794 stw r28,0x3B8(r30); live 2026-10-20: the door in EmMgr slot 23, a Ganado in slot 50

player.action_routine.description: The routine Leon's object action runs (doors: 0x800DDA0C / 0x800DDDC8)
player.action_routine.evidence: 0x80141794 stw r29,0x4C14(r9); the door OPEN callbacks 0x800DD8C4 / 0x800DD964

player.struggle.description: Grab struggle counter (SHAKE OFF): +1 per new stick direction, per new A / B

pad.game_held.description: The game's logical pad, held (low word; control type 0)

pad.game_pressed.description: The game's logical pad, pressed this frame (low word)
pad.game_pressed.evidence: built by 0x80135250; the prompt press check 0x800B1D24 reads it

game.extra_mode.description: The extra game picked on the main menu (pG+0x54): Assignment Ada or The Mercenaries
game.extra_mode.evidence: the main menu's pick 0x80162994 sets 0x80000000 (code 2) / 0x40000000 (code 3); the extras routine 0x801633BC loads omk_t0 / omk_t1 by it; 0x50000000 in a MEM1 taken at Select Player

menu.task0_entry.description: Task 0's entry (scheduler table 0x80289F50, 0x348 a task, entry at +0x33C): title.cpp's task while the title and the menus run, the game loop in a room
menu.task0_entry.evidence: task create 0x80157D5C stores +0x33C; the title task is created by 0x801224B8 (entry 0x80161738); MEM1 from save states: 0x80161738 at Select Player, 0x80116640 at the Village start

menu.title_work.description: The title task's work area (0x60 bytes on the heap): the word after its routine table 0x8020CC10 on its stack; this chain reads it while the task waits in its main loop (gbox/re4_menus.tw searches the stack instead)
menu.title_work.evidence: the title loop 0x8016178C keeps TW in r31 beside the table in r30; task 0's OSThread (+0x18) stack base at +0x304; TW 0x80A55860 at stack top - 0x34 in a MEM1 taken at Select Player

menu.title_routine.description: Title routine (TW+0): which part of the title runs (routine table 0x8020CC10)
menu.title_routine.evidence: the title loop calls table[TW[0]](TW); 6 in a MEM1 taken at Select Player

menu.title_step.description: The routine's step (TW+1). Main menu (5): 1 the menu, 2 New Game, 3 a story game starting, 4 Options, 7 Load. Extras (6): 4 GAME START / EXIT, 8 Select Player, 12 Select Stage, 13 starting
menu.title_step.evidence: the switches of 0x801627C4 (routine 5) and 0x801633BC (routine 6); 8 in a MEM1 taken at Select Player

menu.main_items.description: Main menu: how many items (5 with the extra games unlocked, 3 without)
menu.main_items.evidence: the menu handler 0x801621F0 clamps the cursor to it; 5 at Select Player

menu.main_cursor.description: Main menu cursor (items with the extras unlocked, as the US title shows them; without them: START, LOAD, OPTIONS)
menu.main_cursor.evidence: 0x801621F0: up -1, down +1, A / START pick codes (6, 2, 3, 4, 5) or (1, 4, 5) by pSys+4 & 0x40000000; 2 with The Mercenaries picked at Select Player

menu.merc_cursor.description: The Mercenaries' menu (extras step 4): GAME START or EXIT
menu.merc_cursor.evidence: 0x80163768: A with 0 starts Select Player, with 1 leaves; up sets 0, down 1

menu.player_cursor.description: Select Player cursor (extras step 8): left / right, wraps
menu.player_cursor.evidence: 0x80163F84: left -1, right +1, wrapped to 0..4; A stores pG+0x4FC4 by it; 0 (Leon) at Select Player

menu.stage_cursor.description: Select Stage cursor (extras step 12): a 2 x 2 grid, up / down 2, left / right 1
menu.stage_cursor.evidence: 0x801644C0; reset to 0 when Select Player is confirmed (0x80163F20)
